value.rationale: The exact quadratic conditioning loss under two-orbit radial collision, the small-radius factorial threshold, and an infinite sequence of strict changes of weakest angular mode quantify a natural finite Fock interpolation stability problem not addressed by ordinary sampling density criteria. In particular the sector-switching phenomenon is not a routine first-order Taylor expansion and has a concrete role in selecting the worst interpolation direction.
